{{Quote|Taris is our home. We're not going to wait until the army takes its pick of the planet and then throws us the scraps!|Relus Poh|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Relus Poh''' was an immigrant to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with his sister, [[Jaymizu Poh]], Relus attempted to reclaim his ancestors' estate on Taris, unaware that a group of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] led by [[Achitan]] was living in the house.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Relus Poh was created for the 2011 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If the player is with the Republic faction, he or she can choose whether to help the Pohs take back their ancestors' home as a dark side option, or tell them that the Achitan's deed is a better claim to the property than their ancestors' as a light side option.<ref name="TOR" />
